name: Harness²
summary: Apache-2.0 Google Research framework for recursively improving an agent’s prompts, tools, memory and skills with the model weights left fixed.
description: Fresh open project (repo google-research/harness2; not archived; created 2026-10-06; last pushed 2026-11-02). GitHub SPDX and the README state Apache-2.0. The README disclaimer says this is not an officially supported Google product and is not eligible for the Google Open Source Software Vulnerability Rewards Program. Third-party code, benchmarks and datasets keep their upstream licenses. PyPI package harness2 returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-13; documented install is from a clone: Linux, Python 3.12, uv venv, then uv pip install -e '.[render]'. The local harness2-demo path is documented as requiring no model credentials and as running real Python executions. That demo was not run. Model-backed benchmarks (JobBench, LAB, WorkBuddy-Bench) need further setup (Node.js, Google Cloud CLI / Vertex AI, and Docker for WorkBuddy) and incur API cost; README tells users to start small or use --dry-run. No cloud login or paid run was performed. Site https://harness2.github.io and arXiv 2610.14224 returned HTTP 200. README “Web access”: executor network access is unrestricted, and Codex runs with its sandbox disabled; operators are told to configure network restrictions before evaluation so benchmark answers and grading criteria cannot be fetched. Treat executors as potentially destructive.

agent_access.notes: No verified PyPI package. Documented install is uv pip install -e '.[render]' from the repo. The local demo needs no keys; model-backed benches need cloud/model credentials and were not run.
